pkgmetadata.longdescription: Wazuh agent - the host intrusion detection agent from the Wazuh project (an OSSEC fork): file integrity monitoring, log collection, vulnerability detection and active response, communicating with a Wazuh manager over an encrypted channel. Source-built with Gentoo system libraries wherever a system package exists (see the system-libs patch for the per-library evidence); the remaining vendored dependencies and why each cannot unbundle:

use.flag: Build with Linux audit subsystem support (USE_AUDIT)
